# Policymaker #961, iteration 0225 (trigger: every 3 iterations)

## Decision

No change to policy, routing, parameters, skills or evaluator. No Owner request. `.session/orders.json` is `{"wake": false, "tasks": []}`. The shaper gives the next order.

## What I considered

- Records 0222, 0223 and 0224 are closed. Record 0224 is accepted and improved. `no_progress` is 0. The rollback streak is 1 (2026-11-17).
- Method corrections UF-A to UF-E are closed. Reviews #948 and #954 are CLEAR.
- UF-F task #957 is done and merged at f3e6a2f7.
- Task #958 (new verifier checks for #954 finding 1) is `partial`. The cause is `session_budget`: it used all 45 turns. Commit 27030059 on `task/958` changes `verify_method.py` (+213 lines) and four other files. Its report has no prose ([#958](.session/history/sessions/958/ae3055277c19fdbc7296e58ceff69926cff4cb4eb7646caae55a486c33b8afa8.md)).
- Review #959 is `blocked` because its producer #958 is partial ([#959](.session/history/sessions/959/dc5712a6cf71689ae234fdcc16673c3d25697827d08d2894b7cfe1ea29d51392.md)).

## Why no change

- The orchestrator rule "Resume saved work" already covers #958 (`execution/roles/orchestrator/SKILL.md:145-152`). It orders a finishing task on `start_branch: task/958` with at most 20 turns. This rule worked before (#889 -> #893).
- Expected gain: the verifier checks are finished without a second full task. Check: record 0225 has a `start_branch task/958` task and a #959 changed-scope review with `blocked_by` that task.
- Token counters (not quota): #958 used 5.25M cache_read and #953 used 7.9M. #953 had 7 attempts and 18,942 s of provider waiting. No report shows the cause, so I add no scoping rule. If the finishing task passes 3M or hits its turn cap again, the next Policymaker adds the rule "one verifier check family per task".
- Same-family review (Sonnet reviews Sonnet) continues. This is a stated limitation.

## Limits

Benchmark readiness is false. Product quality is not measured. The Goal gate is not accepted. Details are in `policy/working-memory.md`.

Waiting for the iteration to continue: then `policy/` merges and the orders start.
